also_in_git_history.note: working prose, untracked in HEAD; history deliberately not rewritten, so publication would expose it

digest_note: every digest here was computed from the working tree as it stood when this file was generated, one commit after `generated_after_commit`. An inventory whose digests do not match its files records nothing, so the check that matters is `python scripts/release/build_inventory.py --check`, which recomputes every digest from the files as they are now. Two files were once edited after generation and the inventory described bytes that no longer existed; this is the guard against repeating that.

entries.licence_exception: conservative assignment, not a legal conclusion. The file is 2,560 summary statistics and a row count, carrying no identifier, sequence, structure or measured value -- but it was fitted over 353,957 A-train pairs of which 251,811 (71.14%) have at least one ChEMBL-sourced exact-Ki record, and 67.07% of the 454,694 underlying records are ChEMBL-sourced. Whether a fitted statistic is an 'Adaptation' under CC BY-SA 3.0 is not answered by either provider's published terms. Labelled CC-BY-SA-3.0 so the file is correctly licensed whichever way that resolves; see DATA_LICENSE.draft.

licence_basis.CC-BY-SA-3.0: data whose referenced compounds have measurements with Curation/DataSource = ChEMBL; BindingDB imports those under CC BY-SA 3.0 and ChEMBL confirms the same licence. Share-alike governs where a file mixes sources.

licence_exceptions.note: An exception is a file whose licence needs a stated reason beyond the licence_basis line. Each entry carries that reason in its own `licence_exception` field. Every licence label is a single licence: the earlier revision put the reason inside the label itself ('CC-BY-3.0 (verbatim licence text)'), which made the labels fail to sum to the file count.

provenance_method: row-level Curation/DataSource from the preserved raw payloads; 202609 for B-side entities and the isolated seq2lead_m11c_202601 schema for A-only entities
release_option: A - complete benchmark, pending owner approval. Repository remains PRIVATE.

self_excluded.why: Neither file can record its own digest: writing the digest changes the bytes being described. Verify both by the commit they are attached to.
